{{Top|leg}}
The '''Quenno'''&mdash;meaning "back-to-tradition"&mdash;were a group of [[Saurton]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]] who wanted the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporations that held sway over their planet to leave, and return power to the Saurton [[Council of Elders (Saurton)|Council of Elders]]. They opposed the [[Des'mar]], who believed that, for their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to prosper, they needed the outside trade and culture that the companies brought with them.
